title: 2026 in ads: four changes on Meta and what they ask of your creative
hook: In 2026 Meta put a “Creative diversity” column in Ads Manager. It sums up the year.
caption:
In 2026 Meta put a “Creative diversity” column in Ads Manager. It sums up the year.

By Meta's public statements, Andromeda now scores over a billion ads a second, 100× the 2024 system. GEM reads twice as long a history per person.

Our reading: a system that sharp notices when your ads look alike.

One brand we work with took its creative diversity score from 63 to 92 out of 100, two months after our recommended changes.

For 2027, brief for variety on purpose. Save the last slide and follow @galvor.ai.
alt_text: Seven-slide carousel. Slide 1: 2026 in ads, the year Meta began measuring sameness. Slide 2: Andromeda scores over a billion ads a second, 100× the 2024 system. Slide 3: GEM reads twice as long a history per person, with about 19% more conversions since last year. Slide 4: the Creative diversity column appeared in late August and reached most accounts in the last week of October. Slide 5: one brand's diversity score went from 63 to 92 out of 100. Slide 6: four things these changes ask of you in 2027. Slide 7: follow @galvor.ai.

notes:
